entry.description: bound a single send in `SmtpAppender` to 15 seconds. `SmtpClient.Timeout` defaults to 100 seconds and the appender never set it, and the mail goes out while the appender lock is held, so a server that accepted the connection and then stopped answering suspended every thread logging through the appender. Configurable with `SendTimeoutMillis` (implemented by @FreeAndNil)
